                .thenReturn(oauth1ConnectionFactory);
        when(oauth1ConnectionFactory.getOAuthOperations())

@SuppressWarnings({ "unchecked", "rawtypes" })
@RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class)
public class ConnectControllerTest {}
/**************TEST SETUP BEGIN*************/
@Before
public void setUp() throws Exception{
        ConnectController controller = new ConnectController(connectionFactoryLocator, connectionRepository);
        controller.afterPropertiesSet();
        mockMvc = MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(controller).build();
    }
/**************TEST SETUP END*************/
/**************TEST METHOD BEGIN*************/
@Test
public void oauth2Callback_withStateVerification_completesConnectionAndRedirects() throws Exception{
        AccessGrant accessGrant = new AccessGrant("access-token");

        when(connectionFactoryLocator.getConnectionFactory("facebook"))
                .thenReturn(oauth2ConnectionFactory);
        when(oauth2ConnectionFactory.supportsStateParameter())
                .thenReturn(true);
        when(oauth2ConnectionFactory.getOAuthOperations())
                .thenReturn(oauth2Operations);
        when(oauth2Operations.exchangeForAccess(eq("auth-code"), anyString(), any()))
                .thenReturn(accessGrant);
        when(oauth2ConnectionFactory.createConnection(accessGrant))
                .thenReturn(connection);

        MockHttpSession session = new MockHttpSession();
        session.setAttribute("oauth2State", "known-state");

        mockMvc.perform(get("/connect/facebook")
                        .param("code", "auth-code")
                        .param("state", "known-state")
                        .session(session))
                .andExpect(status().is3xxRedirection())
                .andExpect(redirectedUrl("/connect/facebook"));

        verify(connectionRepository).addConnection(connection);
    }
/**************TEST METHOD END*************/
